tonight.title: The Odyssey
tonight.why: Tonight, ditch the small talk and dive headfirst into 'Avengers: Doomsday,' where three universes collide in a spectacle of heroics and world-ending threats. It’s the kind of high-octane escapism designed to make your couch feel like the front row of an intergalactic battle.

releases.title: Avengers: Doomsday
releases.take: Three universes, one big bad, and enough CGI to make your eyeballs feel like they've run a marathon.

releases.title: Heart of the Beast
releases.take: Man's best friend meets nature's worst intentions in an Alaskan survival tale that's more bite than bark.

releases.title: Other Mommy
releases.take: If your mom suddenly seems a little *too* perfect, maybe check her for tentacles, just in case.

critic.title: The Odyssey
critic.blurb: For the discerning viewer, 'Godzilla Minus Zero' isn't just another monster flick; it's a poignant, visceral exploration of national trauma and resilience, wrapped in the most terrifying and emotionally resonant kaiju film in years. This isn't just spectacle; it's cinema that bites.
